create_CorrBlock: create a CorrBlock from two feature maps to build a 4-level correlation pyramid for optical flow
call_CorrBlock_coords: call a CorrBlock with coordinate tensors to sample bilinear correlation values across pyramid levels
compute_CorrBlock_corr_static: compute all-pairs normalized correlation between two feature map tensors using the static corr method
create_AlternateCorrBlock: create an AlternateCorrBlock from two feature maps to build a multi-level feature pyramid for alternate correlation
call_AlternateCorrBlock_coords: call an AlternateCorrBlock with coordinate tensors to compute CUDA-accelerated correlation across pyramid levels
